3.7V LiPo Battery with JST ACH 1.2mm Connector

Power your wireless builds without the hassle of crimping or soldering. This 3.7V Lithium Polymer (LiPo) battery comes pre-terminated with a JST ACH 1.2mm pitch connector, specifically chosen to be a direct plug-and-play match for the Wireless Lily 58 SMT.

The Perfect Fit

Most standard LiPo batteries ship with JST-PH 2.0mm connectors that are too large for ultra-compact wireless splits. We sourced these batteries specifically to eliminate this problem. These batteries mate perfectly with the BM02B-ACHSS-GAN-ETF headers used on our wireless PCBs, ensuring a secure, low-profile connection that fits inside even the slimmest cases.

Compatibility

This battery is the official power source for the Boardsource wireless ecosystem but is compatible with any project requiring a 3.7V cell and an ACH connector.

  • Wireless Lily 58 SMT: Fits perfectly in the compact central battery cutout.

Safety & Specs

  • Voltage: 3.7V Nominal

  • Connector: JST ACH (1.2mm Pitch)

  • Protection: Integrated PCM (Protection Circuit Module) to prevent overcharging and over-discharging.

top_features: Pre-terminated JST-ACH 1.2mm connector: Enables direct, plug-and-play connection without soldering or crimping
Integrated PCM protection circuit: Prevents overcharging and over-discharging for enhanced safety
Ultra-compact design: Fits perfectly in slim wireless PCBs and central battery cutouts
Official compatibility with Wireless Lily 58 SMT: Ensures perfect fit and reliable performance
Rechargeable lithium polymer technology: Provides reliable, long-lasting power for repeated use
unique_selling_points: Pre-terminated JST-ACH 1.2mm connector eliminates crimping and ensures a secure fit in ultra-compact wireless projects.
